import sys

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(input[0])
    s = input[1]
    arr = list(s)
    max_segment = 0
    nested_count = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if arr[i] == '(':
            c = 0
            j = i + 1
            while j < n:
                if arr[j] == ')':
                    if c > 0:
                        nested_count += 1
                    break
                if arr[j] == '_':
                    if c > 0:
                        nested_count += 1
                        c = 0
                else:
                    c += 1
                j += 1
        elif arr[i] == ')' or arr[i] == '_':
            c = 0
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and arr[j] not in [')', '_', '(']:
                c += 1
                j += 1
            if c > max_segment:
                max_segment = c
        else:
            c = 0
            j = i
            while j < n and arr[j] not in [')', '_', '(']:
                c += 1
                j += 1
            if c > max_segment:
                max_segment = c
            i += c - 1
        i += 1
    print(f"{max_segment} {nested_count}")
